issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies Animal.name as type String, but the solution implementation declares the name attribute as StringBuilder. This is a structural type mismatch for a core attribute and may confuse students or graders expecting the name field to be a String as described in the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification by changing the Animal.name field to type String (replace StringBuilder with String) and update the constructor and setter to store the provided String directly. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to indicate StringBuilder if that was intended.
